content.title: SKF 6205-2RS Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 25x52x15mm, Chrome Steel, ABEC-1
content.short_description: SKF 6205-2RS deep groove ball bearing with 25mm bore, 52mm OD, 15mm width. Chrome steel construction with dual rubber seals, ABEC-1/P0 precision class.
content.long_description:
The SKF 6205-2RS is a single-row deep groove ball bearing with a 25 mm bore diameter, 52 mm outer diameter, and 15 mm width. Rings and balls are manufactured from chrome steel (GCr15/52100), a through-hardening bearing steel commonly used for rolling element components. The bearing is rated to ABEC-1/P0 precision class, the standard tolerance grade for general industrial applications.

The "2RS" designation indicates rubber seals fitted on both sides of the bearing, providing contact sealing to retain lubricant and restrict entry of contaminants at the bore and outer diameter interfaces. This configuration is typically selected when the application does not require a shielded (non-contact) seal design.

MPN 6205-2RS corresponds to the standard metric 62-series bearing size designation. Confirm shaft and housing fit dimensions against the stated bore (25 mm), OD (52 mm), and width (15 mm) before installation.
